experience.description: Led the migration of ETL workflows from SQL Server to Google BigQuery, refactoring legacy T-SQL and Excel logic to optimize compute resources and engineering a Python-based automated QA framework. Designed and implemented a Salesforce-to-BigQuery replication architecture using Google Datastream. Refactored a multi-source replication module (SQL Server, Salesforce) improving maintainability. Operated and monitored SQL Server replication pipelines ensuring reliable CDC-based sync.
Solving SQL issues on the manufacture area, helping different teams with errors analysis and solving through finding the root cause.
